result.question: Quais são os 5 municípios com maior percentual de internações em UTI (com mais de 5000 internações)?
result.gold_sql: SELECT mu.nome AS municipio, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i."VAL_UTI" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_uti FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d GROUP BY mu.nome HAVING COUNT(*) > 5000 ORDER BY pct_uti DESC LIMIT 5;
result.generated_sql: WITH total_internacoes AS ( SELECT "MUNIC_RES", COUNT(*) AS total FROM internacoes GROUP BY "MUNIC_RES" HAVING COUNT(*) > 5000 ), uti_internacoes AS ( SELECT "MUNIC_RES", COUNT(*) AS total_uti FROM internacoes WHERE "VAL_UTI" > 0 GROUP BY "MUNIC_RES" ) SELECT mu."nome" AS municipio, ROUND(COALESCE(100.0 * u.total_uti / t.total, 0), 2) AS proporcao, t.total AS total_internacoes FROM total_internacoes t JOIN uti_internacoes u ON t."MUNIC_RES" = u."MUNIC_RES" JOIN municipios mu ON t."MUNIC_RES" = mu."codigo_6d" ORDER BY proporcao DESC LIMIT 5;
